criteria.requirement: Add optional serializer(record_snapshot, formatted_text) to Logger.add and real Handler emission, independently per sink and before enqueue. Require callable or None and reject simultaneous serialize=True; default boolean JSON output remains unchanged. Pass a deep detached supported record graph (traceback may be retained read-only), preserving other sinks/original nested extra/record attrs against callback mutation; unsupported deepcopy values fail under existing catch policy. Require a string result with callback-owned terminators, invoke exactly once per emitted handler record on the producer thread, and keep catch=False exception propagation and queue completion. Never route custom encoding through a replacement fake sink.
